name: Aqua Security - Image Security and Compliance
description: Aqua Security - Image Security and Compliance dashboard monitors image scanning and assurance events from Aqua such as image vulnerability, malware and compliance issue findings.
title: Aqua Security - Image Security and Compliance

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Aqua "policy.failure" "image.policy"
| json "rule_type", "result", "image", "category", "action", "podnamespace", "poddeployment", "reason", "containerid", "resource", "data", "user" nodrop
| json field=data "controls", "policy_id", "policy_name", "blocking" nodrop
| parse regex field=controls "\"(?<control>.+?)\"" multi
| toLowerCase(action) as action_f | toLowerCase(user) as user_f 
| where action_f = "policy.failure" and user_f = "image.policy"
| count_distinct(image) as distinct_images by image, control
| sort by image

_sourceCategory = Labs/Aqua malware "policy.failure" "image.policy"
| json "rule_type", "result", "image", "category", "action", "podnamespace", "poddeployment", "reason", "containerid", "resource", "data", "user" nodrop
| json field=data "controls", "policy_id", "policy_name", "blocking" nodrop
| toLowerCase(action) as action_f | toLowerCase(user) as user_f 
| where action_f = "policy.failure" and user_f = "image.policy" and controls contains "malware"
| count_distinct(image) as distinct_images by image

_sourceCategory = Labs/Aqua max_severity "policy.failure" "image.policy"
| json "rule_type", "result", "image", "category", "action", "podnamespace", "poddeployment", "reason", "containerid", "resource", "data", "user" nodrop
| json field=data "controls", "policy_id", "policy_name", "blocking" nodrop
| toLowerCase(action) as action_f | toLowerCase(user) as user_f 
| where action_f = "policy.failure" and user_f = "image.policy" and controls contains "max_severity"
| count_distinct(image) as distinct_images by image
